fieldValues.title: Who decides a repository's top-level areas, and how does its purpose become structure?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: No option chosen. Raised as an open question in Research (2. Reading order and sections: a few areas, then deeper), 2026-10-30, and turned into an exercise so options are explored before any decision.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. The owner, by hand.
- B. A guided conversation per repository purpose, ending in a proposed structure.
- C. An agent proposes it from the records (the dream cycle) and the owner adjusts.
- D. Defaults from a blueprint or package, changed per repository.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Which way produced structures that stayed stable and readable: srs-context, muSrs, LiveWyer and Research were each structured differently.
fieldValues.next_action: Compare those four structures: who made them, how, and how much they changed afterwards.
